We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 6 reactions, using templates in order: ['20810', '2895', '1914397', '1914398', '1914399', '74054'].

We have applied first three templates: 20810 gave two fragments: fragment A: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1" and fragment B: "O=S(=O)(Cl)c1ccccc1F". Good.

Then applied 2895 to fragment A gave nitrated version: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1". Good.

Then we attempted 1914397 on fragment B but got no result. Then applied 1914397 on nitrated fragment gave two fragments: "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCNCC1" and "O=[N+]([O-])c1cc(Br)c2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". So template 1914397 splits the nitrated aromatic heterocycle? It gave a simple tertiary amine fragment and a brominated nitro aromatic fused ring.

Now we need to apply template 1914398 to the second fragment (the nitro-bromo fused ring). We did that, got fragments: "BrBr" and "O=[N+]([O-])c1ccc2c(c1)CCC1(CCC1)O2". So 1914398 splits off a bromine leaving the core.

Now we need to apply template 1914399 next. We need to get that template. Let's fetch it.
